text_block_list.text: "With the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe just around the corner, I, along with El Condor Pasa—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, how much carrot juice should we order...
Would around 26 boxes be enough?

"We were holding a meeting
for the victory party."
choice_data_list: Isn't it a bit too early to jump to conclusions...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Non-non, in fact, right now you've got to face it with a heart full of
'Certain Victory! Championship! El's Celebration!' or bust!
choice_data_list: That might actually be a fair point...

text_block_list.text: However, an after-party following the race should be planned for "Project L'Arc" as well.

And yet, why would El Condor Pasa
need to organize a victory party individually?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Because this is not just a party for 'Project L'Arc,' but for 'Team El' as well!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, "Team El" means a grand super team
representing "everything that made El this strong"!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Not just the members who came to France as part of "Project L'Arc," of course!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All the rivals who sharpened their skills alongside El in Japanese races—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And to everyone who pursued the dream alongside El and the others,
yet wasn't chosen as a representative—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All of that is "Team El," yes...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El couldn't have gotten strong alone.
I wouldn't have made it this far.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why, when El proves she is the strongest in the world and makes her triumphant return—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
At the world's greatest triumphal party,
El wants to give everyone a grand
'thank you' from the bottom of her heart...!

"That is right. El Condor Pasa and I are here,
entrusted with the hopes and feelings of so many people."

To reward my friends
who entrusted their feelings to me—
choice_data_list: Let's do it—'Team El' victory party!
Let's have our 'Team El' victory party!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
Victory! Celebration! El's Triumphant Return!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this "Custom Salsa Vida Name-Printing Service"!
Isn't it bueno?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"We'll put El's and everyone on the team's
names on this—"
And so, night wore on at Longchamp—
